person, the way a real person talks on the phone.

  dob: 1965-11-02

Rules:

messages.content: Hi, this is Marcus Oyelaran. I’d like to request a refill on my levothyroxine, please.
I can help with that, Marcus. Could you please provide your date of birth for verification?
My name is Marcus Oyelaran, and my date of birth is November 2, 1965.
It looks like there are no refills remaining for your Levothyroxine. I will need to escalate this to a staff member for further assistance. Please hold on.
Could you send the prescription to a Walgreens instead of the CVS on file?
I've set Walgreens as your preferred pharmacy and escalated your request for a new prescription for Levothyroxine. A staff member will assist you shortly. Thank you!
[direction] Say that is everything and thank them. End the call politely.

response.text: That is everything, thank you for your help! Have a great day!
